conversation.Statement: This is Officer Daniel Carter with the Federal Investigation Unit of the IRS. Who am I speaking with?
Uh, hi, this is Jamie Miller. I got a message saying there was an issue with my taxes?
Jamie, I am reviewing your federal tax records right now. There are several discrepancies from your last two returns. Are you aware of any unpaid tax obligations or errors on your filings?
No, I-I just started my job last year. I used some online service to file. Is something wrong?
The IRS has flagged your account due to substantial underreporting of income and failure to pay the correct taxes. The outstanding balance is significant, and interest has been accumulating daily.
I-I don't understand, I thought I filled everything out right. How much do I owe?
Including penalties, interest, and legal processing fees, you currently owe $5,970.42. If this is not settled today, we will move forward with enforcement actions.
Enforcement? What does that mean? I-I can't pay that much right now, I have loans and rent,

Jamie, if you fail to settle your tax debt immediately, the IRS will issue a lien against your bank accounts and freeze your wages. Your driver's license could also be suspended, and criminal charges may be filed.
No, please! I can't have my accounts frozen. Will this hurt my credit?
Yes, a federal lien will severely damage your credit, and you could face arrest for tax evasion. If you cooperate right now, we may be able to resolve this without further escalation.
Okay, okay. What do I need to do? I don't have that much money.

We can accept an immediate partial settlement to halt legal action. You must submit payment now via a secure method such as cryptocurrency, direct wire, or prepaid gift cards. Which of these can you arrange within the hour?
Um, I don't know how to send crypto... I guess maybe I can get gift cards?
You need to stay on the line with me, Jamie. Go to your nearest store and purchase $1,500 in Target or Apple gift cards. Do not discuss this with anyone. The IRS is monitoring your compliance.
Why gift cards? This doesn't sound normal,
Do not question federal procedures! If you do not follow instructions exactly, your case will be referred for immediate arrest and asset seizure.
I'm sorry, I just... I'm scared. I'll go to the store now.
Good. Once you have the cards, you must provide me the numbers on the back for verification. Do not hang up or speak to anyone at the store about this case.
Okay, I'm leaving now. I have to walk, it might take a little bit.
You have 40 minutes to complete this task. Any delay will result in a warrant for your arrest. Inform me when you arrive at the store.
All right, I'm almost there. I'm really nervous.
Remain calm and do not draw attention to yourself. Purchase the cards and return to this line immediately. Failure to comply will be seen as an attempt to evade federal law.
Okay, I'm getting the gift cards now.
Once you have them, read each card number and the code on the back to me. Do not make any mistakes or the payment will not register and further penalties will apply.
